rationale: Started 2026-11-10T08:19:02Z; ended 2026-11-10T08:34:20Z (UTC). I did not produce this decision. Every source_fingerprints file re-hashed to its pinned digest, each checked record's text_path re-hashed to its text_sha256, and each quoted text equals the exact char_start:char_end slice of its held file. I read the original in full (26 FR 3951): EO 10938 of May 4, 1961 establishes the President's Foreign Intelligence Advisory Board, sets its review and six-monthly reporting duties and member compensation, and revokes EO 10656 (spent on issue); identity is confirmed, and the reporting clause is a report deadline, not an end. The held FR text of EO 11460 (34 FR 5535, Mar. 20, 1969) says in Sec. 6 that Executive Order No. 10938 of May 4, 1961 is hereby revoked, with no deferred effect or savings; the APP text and the current 50 U.S.C. 3023 note (current-law MENTIONS) agree. Cruden found no other ending text, so the whole order ended 1969-03-20 and status no holds.
